fields.name: Greek Salad
fields.description: A fresh and vibrant Mediterranean salad made with crisp vegetables, olives, and feta cheese.
fields.ingredients: Tomatoes, cucumbers, red onion, olives, feta cheese, olive oil, oregano, salt.
fields.directions: Combine all chopped vegetables, top with feta and olives, drizzle with olive oil, season, and toss gently.

fields.name: Caesar Salad
fields.description: A classic crisp salad with romaine lettuce, creamy dressing, croutons, and Parmesan.
fields.ingredients: Romaine lettuce, Caesar dressing, croutons, Parmesan cheese, black pepper.
fields.directions: Toss lettuce with dressing, add croutons and Parmesan, then season and serve.

fields.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
fields.description: A warm, rich chocolate cake with a soft, gooey molten center.
fields.ingredients: Dark chocolate, butter, eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla.
fields.directions: Mix melted chocolate with batter, pour into molds, bake briefly until the center remains molten.

fields.name: Mojito
fields.description: A refreshing Cuban cocktail with mint, lime, and sparkling sweetness.
fields.ingredients: Mint leaves, lime, sugar, white rum, soda water, ice.
fields.directions: Muddle mint with sugar and lime, add rum and ice, then top with soda and stir.

fields.name: Noodle Soup
fields.description: A warm, comforting bowl of broth with tender noodles and simple seasonings.
fields.ingredients: Broth, noodles, vegetables, salt, pepper, herbs.
fields.directions: Simmer broth with vegetables, add noodles until cooked, season to taste, and serve hot.

fields.name: Margherita Pizza
fields.description: A classic Italian pizza made with fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil.
fields.ingredients: Pizza dough, tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, basil leaves, olive oil, salt
fields.directions: Spread the sauce on the dough, add mozzarella and basil, then bake until done.

fields.name: Sweet Apple Pastry
fields.description: A light and sweet pastry filled with soft baked apples.
fields.ingredients: Puff pastry, apples, sugar, cinnamon, butter
fields.directions: Fill the pastry with apples and bake until golden brown.

fields.name: Chocolate Dessert
fields.description: A quick and sweet chocolate dessert for any occasion.
fields.directions: Mix the ingredients and bake until set.

fields.name: Fresh Lemonade
fields.description: A refreshing homemade drink perfect for hot days.
fields.directions: Mix lemon juice with water and sugar, then serve with ice.

fields.name: Vegetable Soup
fields.description: A warm and simple soup made with fresh vegetables.
fields.ingredients: Carrots, potatoes, onion, celery, water, salt
fields.directions: Boil the vegetables in water until soft.

fields.name: Butter Croissant
fields.description: A flaky and buttery French pastry.
fields.ingredients: Flour, butter, milk, yeast, sugar, salt
fields.directions: Shape the dough and bake until golden.

fields.name: Pepperoni Pizza
fields.description: A classic pizza topped with pepperoni and melted cheese.
fields.ingredients: Pizza dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, pepperoni, olive oil
fields.directions: Spread the sauce on the dough, add toppings, and bake until crispy.

fields.name: Four Cheese Pizza
fields.description: A rich pizza made with a blend of four cheeses.
fields.ingredients: Pizza dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella, parmesan, gorgonzola, cheddar
fields.directions: Add the cheeses on the sauce and bake until melted and golden.

fields.name: Iced Coffee
fields.description: A cold and energizing coffee drink.
fields.directions: Pour coffee over ice, add milk and sugar, then stir.

fields.name: Vanilla Mug Cake
fields.description: A quick and fluffy vanilla cake you can make in the microwave in just a few minutes.
fields.ingredients: Flour, sugar, baking powder, milk, vegetable oil, vanilla extract.
fields.directions: Mix all ingredients in a mug until smooth. Microwave for about 1–2 minutes until the cake rises and is fully cooked. Let it cool slightly and enjoy.

fields.name: Strawberry Yogurt Parfait
fields.description: A light and refreshing dessert made with layers of yogurt, fresh strawberries, and crunchy granola.
fields.ingredients: Greek yogurt, fresh strawberries, granola, honey, mint leaves (optional).
fields.directions: Layer yogurt, sliced strawberries, and granola in a glass. Drizzle with honey and repeat the layers. Garnish with mint leaves and serve immediately.

fields.name: Baked Cinnamon Apples
fields.description: A warm and comforting dessert with soft baked apples and a sweet cinnamon flavor.
fields.ingredients: Apples, brown sugar, butter, cinnamon, honey.
fields.directions: Core the apples and place them in a baking dish. Fill the centers with brown sugar, butter, and cinnamon. Drizzle with honey and bake until the apples are soft.

fields.name: Vegan Avocado Toast with Chickpeas
fields.description: A quick and nutritious vegan meal packed with healthy fats and plant-based protein. Perfect for breakfast or a light lunch.
fields.ingredients: Whole grain bread, ripe avocado, canned chickpeas, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes.
fields.directions: Toast the bread and mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Top with chickpeas and a drizzle of olive oil, then sprinkle chili flakes before serving.
